cohort: Women with repeated implantation failure (RIF) or recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL) who underwent endometrial biopsy with CD138 immunohistochemistry.
finding: The study found no significant increase in CE prevalence with increasing numbers of failed embryo transfers or miscarriages, and no relevant differences in the reproductive outcomes of RIF patients with normal biopsies compared with those treated for CE.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of chronic endometritis in women with recurrent pregnancy loss.
